newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 10,700 MT were primarily the result of major increases for the Philippines (19,000 MT) and Canada (11,900 MT) being partially offset by reductions for Thailand (20,000 MT, corrected to 1997/98).
Sales of 85,800 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were for unknown destinations (40,000 MT), Ireland (24,000 MT), and Thailand (20,000 MT, from 1996/97).

Exports of 29,200 MT were off two-thirds from the previous week and 62 percent from the 4-week average. Colombia (9,200 MT), Canada (7,500 MT), and the Dominican Republic (6,300 MT) were the principal recipients.
